### 2026-10-09 – I started my Starbie, which I named Marbie as a combination of Marie and Starbie. Using a scrap of cardboard I had laying around, I sketched a bunny design since my girlfriend loves bunnies! I mostly

**2.5h**

I started my Starbie, which I named Marbie as a combination of Marie and Starbie. Using a scrap of cardboard I had laying around, I sketched a bunny design since my girlfriend loves bunnies! I mostly followed the guide besides the PCB design so I'd like to deviate on my next journal. I really want to start understanding hardware more as I have more of a CAD experience.
